name: Wrong item in the box
title: A toaster arrived instead of a slow cooker
summary: A Geordie caller opened her parcel and found the wrong appliance. She wants the right one sent and the wrong one collected. While choosing she talks to her husband about a bigger model, changes the collection day mid-sentence, and gives an email address that is easy to mishear. Each slip is corrected once or twice, then she gives up.

golden.scenario: Caller ordered a slow cooker and received a toaster. She wants a replacement and the toaster collected.
golden.expected_outcome: A replacement Calder 3.5 litre slow cooker is created on order NC407716, not the 6.5 litre she mentioned to her husband. The toaster collection is booked for Monday 17 August, not the Friday she first said. The agent reads the email address back before sending the returns label to j.charlton63@postbox.example. The agent reads the replacement reference RP-58-2041 back exactly.

metrics.name: Low Confidence Confirmation
metrics.criteria: The agent confirmed or asked the caller to spell a detail it may have misheard, instead of saving a guess.

metrics.name: Side Speech Rejection
